''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of the novel to [[41 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' further states that the [[mission to Pijal]], dated to [[40 BBY]] by ''Timelines'', occurred after the civil war. "''This is the Way.|[[Din Djarin]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]|}} [[Duke]] '''Adonai Kryze''' was the [[Mandalorian]] father of [[Satine Kryze]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze]].{{Databank|bo-katan-kryze|Bo-Katan Kryze}} He was part of [[House Kryze]], that was the royal family of the Mandalorians. A few [[Standard decade|decades]] prior to [[Clone Wars]], [[Kalevala]]'s House Kryze occupied a leading position among the Mandalorian clans, with Adonai Kryze—Duke of Kalevala—having been the leader of the Mandalorians during this [[time]]. When Bo-Katan was a child, she took the [[Mandalorian Creed]] by performing a [[Mandalorian initiation ritual]] in the [[Living Waters]] in the [[Mines of Mandalore]], and was showered with gifts, while Adonai looked on proudly. Between [[41 BBY]] and [[40 BBY]] escalating tensions between Mandalorian clans led to the outbreak of the [[Great Clan Wars]]. During the wars, Kryze emerged as a [[warlord]] of House Kryze and gained respect from his enemies, including [[Death Watch]]. Kryze realized through the long course of the war that constant fighting would not bring prosperity for Mandalore, and thus he sent his daughter, [[Satine Kryze]] to [[Galactic Republic]] [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]] to study diplomacy. On Mandalore, he was killed during the war while defending the planet, and was succeeded by his pacifistic daughter, Duchess [[Satine Kryze]]. [[Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla]] considered Satine unworthy to lead the [[Mandalorian]]s, and so planned an alliance with [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. According to Bo-Katan, he was a great man. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Adonai Kryze was named and first introduced into the current [[canon]] by [[Tim Veekhoven]] as part of the lore he introduced while writing the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon|''Build the Millennium Falcon'']] magazine.Social media correspondence with [[Tim Veekhoven]] {{C|[[:File:TimVeekhoven-Credits.pdf|screenshot]]}} ==Appearances== *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore}} {{Mo}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 20: The Foundling}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{BuildFalconCite|32|Guide to the Galaxy}} {{1stm}} *{{GermanFanCite|104|Database}} *{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-18-the-mines-of-mandalore-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' – "Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore"}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Adonai Kryze |fr=Adonai Kryze |ja=アドナイ・クライズ |ka=ადონაი კრიზი |nl=Adonai Kryze |tr=Adonai Kryze }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Kryze, Adonai}} [[Category:Clan Kryze]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
